 11.11 2026 Promo Today: Shopee, Tokopedia, Lazada, and Blibli Discounts, Check the Terms
 The 11.11 2026 online shopping festival is here, featuring major discounts across Shopee, Tokopedia, Lazada, and Blibli. Check the promo terms, flash sales, and safe shopping tips.
 By: Adit Pranata 
 | 
 Editor: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Contributor: Nadine Safitri 
 November 11, 2026, 00:51 WITA · 6 min read 
 Close ad × 
 Advertisement 
 Photo caption: Illustration of a consumer accessing 11.11 2026 promos via smartphone to find discounts, vouchers, and online shopping offers. (Illustration/Aktualita.co) 
 JAKARTA, Aktualita.co -  The 11.11 online shopping festival is back today, Wednesday (11/11/2026). A number of e-commerce platforms such as Shopee, Tokopedia, TikTok Shop, Lazada, and Blibli are offering various price cuts, shopping vouchers, and flash sale programs with limited quotas. 
 This double-date promo has become one of the shopping moments consumers look forward to toward the end of the year. Various products, ranging from electronics, clothing, and household appliances to daily necessities, are included in the discount programs prepared by each platform. 
 Advertisement 
 The scale of the offers varies. Shopee is presenting discounts of up to 90 percent, Lazada is offering cuts of up to 95 percent, while Blibli has prepared promos with discount values reaching IDR 3 million for certain products. 
 However, consumers need to pay attention to the requirements for each promotion. Not all discounts apply to all products, and some vouchers can only be used at certain times or through designated payment methods. 
 Shopee 11.11 Big Sale, Featuring IDR 11,000 Flash Sale 
 Shopee has been holding its 11.11 Big Sale campaign since October 25 through November 12, 2026. This program features three main offers: the 11RB Big Flash Sale, Buy 2 Get 1 Free, and Jumbo Discounts of up to 90 percent. 
 Through the Big Flash Sale, consumers have the opportunity to get selected products at prices starting from IDR 11,000. Meanwhile, the jumbo discount program covers various categories, including beauty, fashion, electronics, and household needs. 
 Shopee also provides additional vouchers through a number of promotional programs and specific payment methods. 
 Although they offer large discounts, consumers still need to check the final price when making a payment. The quota for flash sale products can run out at any time, while vouchers have their own respective requirements and usage limits. 
 Tokopedia and TikTok Shop Offer Billions of Rupiah in Prizes 
 Tokopedia, together with TikTok Shop, is also enlivening the shopping festival through the 11.11 2026 Guncang Promo campaign. 
 Tokopedia has prepared the War Traktiran program with a total prize pool reaching IDR 2 billion, accompanied by various flash sale offers. Meanwhile, TikTok Shop is presenting the Panglima Promo game with a total prize pool of IDR 1 billion and a free shipping program. 
 The billions of rupiah figure represents the total value of prizes prepared for the promotional program, not a discount automatically received by every user. 
 Senior Director of Tokopedia and TikTok Shop Indonesia, Vonny Ernita Susamto, said the double-date shopping campaign is also aimed at expanding opportunities for local business players. 
 "Online shopping activity drives the economy and opens opportunities for local business players. Through the 11.11 2026 Guncang Promo, we invite the public to #BuyLocal and #ShopSafely through a trusted discovery commerce ecosystem." 
 This statement was made by Vonny during a press conference in Jakarta on Monday (9/11/2026). 
 Previously, transactions during the 10.10 2026 campaign were reported to have increased up to ninefold on Tokopedia and fourfold on TikTok Shop. That growth demonstrates the scale of public shopping activity during the double-date festival. 
 Lazada 11.11 Presents Discounts of up to 95 Percent 
 Lazada Indonesia opened the main period of its 11.11 promo on Tuesday (10/11/2026) at 8:00 PM WIB and has scheduled it to run until Friday (13/11/2026). 
 One of its flagship programs is the Crazy Brand Mega Offer, which offers discounts of up to 95 percent and vouchers with values reaching IDR 1.5 million. 
 Lazada is also presenting Exclusive Surprise Deals every day at 8:00 PM WIB through the official LazMall store channel. These offers include additional price cuts and exclusive products from a number of brands. 
 After the main period, Lazada has also scheduled an Extended Sale from November 14–15, 2026. 
 Commercial Director of Lazada Indonesia, Erika Agustine, believes that consumer behavior is changing because buyers are no longer just considering the size of the discount. 
 "We see that Indonesian consumers are becoming smarter in shopping for their needs, where they balance benefits and price." 
 Erika's statement was delivered during a press conference in Jakarta on Monday (9/11/2026). 
 Extending the promotional period gives consumers the opportunity to compare products and consider their decisions before making a transaction. 
 Blibli Histeria 11.11, Discounts of up to IDR 3 Million 
 Blibli has been holding its Histeria 11.11 campaign since November 3, with the peak period taking place from November 11–13, 2026. 
 During the peak period, the platform is offering discounts of up to IDR 3 million for certain products, including gadgets, sports equipment, electronics, and household needs. 
 Blibli has also prepared a Voucher Rush Hour with an additional discount of up to 50 percent, with a maximum of IDR 100,000. 
 These vouchers are scheduled to be available at 11:00 AM, 1:00 PM, 3:00 PM, and 5:00 PM WIB every day during the peak promo period. 
 Other offers include a Hot Picks Clearance Sale with discounts of up to 90 percent and a Buy 1 Get 1 Free program for selected products. 
 All programs follow their respective terms and conditions, so the promotional prices displayed are not necessarily available to all users. 
 Additional Promos from Banks, Can You Save More? 
 Beyond marketplace price cuts, several banks are offering additional discounts for transactions using specific cards. 
 Bank Rakyat Indonesia (BRI), for example, is providing a debit card promo on Shopee in the form of a 10 percent discount with a maximum cut of IDR 120,000 for a minimum transaction of IDR 1 million. 
 On Tokopedia, BRI debit card users have the opportunity to get a 10 percent discount of up to IDR 100,000 with a minimum purchase of IDR 250,000 at the Official Store. 
 BRI is also offering a discount of IDR 350,000 on Lazada for transactions of at least IDR 3 million using a credit card, with a limited quota. 
 However, banking promos generally have additional conditions, including card usage limits, product categories, and prohibitions on combining them with certain vouchers. 
 Tips for Safe Shopping During the 11.11 2026 Promo 
 Amidst the many offers, consumers should not rush into making purchases just because they see a large discount figure. 
 The first step is to compare the price of the same product across several marketplaces. Also, check whether the price after the discount is actually lower than the previous normal price. 
 Next, pay attention to the voucher usage terms, including the minimum spend, quota, validity period, and payment method. Shipping costs and service fees also need to be calculated so that total expenditure does not exceed the budget. 
 For purchases of electronic goods, consumers are advised to check the specifications, warranty, and seller reputation before completing the payment. 
 Transaction security is no less important. Avoid suspicious promotional links that ask for OTP codes, PINs, or account information. Use official applications and do not make payments through personal accounts sent outside the marketplace system. 
 The 11.11 2026 promo festival does indeed open up opportunities to obtain goods at lower prices. However, true savings are not determined by the size of the discount percentage, but by price suitability, product quality, and consumer needs. 
 By carefully comparing offers, the public can take advantage of the double-date shopping momentum without getting trapped in impulsive buying.
